original_target.title: Boundary contact of the second nodal set in convex domains

scope_comparison: Freitas–Leylekian's current construction uses nonconvex doubly-connected PLANAR domains. It does not refute a bounded smooth convex domain in dimension>=3. Neumann hot-spots counterexamples and Dirichlet–buckling comparisons concern different operators/quantities. No unrestricted high-dimensional convex Dirichlet nodal-contact resolution located.
